sloka: व्रणैः सास्त्रैरशोभेतां पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ ।युद्ध्यमानौ परिश्रान्तौ जानुभ्यामवनीं गतौ ।। ६.५४.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: vraṇaiḥ sāstrairaśobhetāṁ puṣpitāviva kiṁśukau ।yuddhyamānau pariśrāntau jānubhyāmavanīṁ gatau ।। 6.54.33 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada, the elephant among the monkeys rose up in the mere twinkling of eyes, like a serpent struck by staff glowing in his eyes.
